_note: Test-build rules. Sources: composition doc 2 (30 deg, 50% table horizon, odd/even, depth bands, condiment 1-3in), knowledge base tableware ref s7 (spacing, margins), plan 2a (SKU on diner's right).

closer._note: Fernando 2026-09-27: 20 deg instead of 30, and about 25% closer than the 30 deg framing. The distance is 25% under the tightest 30 deg fit; at that distance the rear table edge lands at 46-50% of frame height, above some blueprint clamps (0.42-0.48), so tableHorizonMax here replaces the blueprint clamp. Set it to null to keep the blueprint clamps (the camera then stops as close as they allow, about 12-17% closer).

placeSetting._note: Fernando 2026-09-27: DISH near the diner's front edge; everything else a contained set around it, never spread across the table or near the other edges.
